title: Venezuelan Oxtail Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Venezuela, made with tender oxtail and bold spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown oxtail on all sides, remove from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and sauté onion until softened.
Add garlic and chili peppers and cook for 1 minute.
Add chili powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth and red wine to the pot.
Return oxtail to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until oxtail is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
